name: Merge PDF
desc: Combine several PDF files into one, in any order
seoTitle: Merge PDF Files Online: Free, No Upload
seoDescription: Combine PDF files into one document online for free. Add several PDFs, put them in order, and download the merged file. Your files never leave your device.
intro: Join multiple PDFs into a single file. Add your documents, use the arrows to set the order, and download the result. Everything runs in your browser, so contracts, invoices and personal documents are never uploaded.
steps: Drop two or more PDF files into the box.
Use the up and down arrows to put them in the order you want.
Click Merge and download the combined PDF.

faq.q: Is there a limit on pages or files?
faq.a: The tool sets no limit, but very large PDFs need more memory, so huge merges work best on a computer.

faq.q: Are my PDFs uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Merging happens in your browser, so your documents stay on your device.
